liveryDetails: White left/right REAR-edge strips stay visible in every pose on the rear plane (z=0). Exposed side panels remain marine blue. White rear bumper and wheel-arch trims; dark canvas roof. No promotional poster text or quantity claims copied.
plateNote: User-requested single Chinese plate glyph, hand-drawn as integer pixels. The central plate is the car's only lettering; the white bumper has no additional badge. The glyph is stamped after pose mirroring.
rearWhiteStripPlane: rear plane z=0; both strips present in every pose; no white side-plane wrap
